paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples with a larger number of examples
model_annotation: The line chart compares the performance of two example selection strategies—ST-ES and Random—as measured by minFDE₂₀ (in units of distance) across varying numbers of in-context examples, ranging from 0 to 15. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Examples,” is linearly scaled from 0 to 15 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “minFDE₂₀ (←),” is linearly scaled from 0.85 to 1.05 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.01. The ST-ES strategy is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at a value of approximately 1.05 at 0 examples and decreasing to approximately 0.82 at 15 examples, with a steep initial drop followed by a gradual leveling off. The Random strategy is represented by an orange line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 1.04 at 0 examples and fluctuating slightly around a value of approximately 0.98 from 2 to 15 examples, showing minor oscillations without a clear trend.

model_annotations.English: This line plot compares the performance of two example selection strategies—ST-ES and Random—as measured by the minimum FDE₂₀ metric, across a varying number of in-context examples. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Examples,” spans from 0 to 15 and uses a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of approximately 1.5 units. The y-axis, labeled “minFDE₂₀ (←),” ranges from 0.85 to 1.05 and also uses a linear scale, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.05. The ST-ES strategy is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid line style, which begins at a value of approximately 1.05 at 0 examples and exhibits a steep decline to approximately 0.83 at 1 example, followed by a gradual, noisy decrease to a steady value around 0.825 from 2 to 15 examples. The Random strategy is represented by an orange line with circular markers and a solid line style, which starts at approximately 1.04 at 0 examples, then gradually declines to approximately 0.975 from 1 to 15 examples, showing a relatively stable performance with minor fluctuations.
